test_GTestHelpTest: test the GTestHelpTest class to verify Google Test help flag behavior with various flag variants
run_RUNWithFlag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_TestHelpFlag: test that the correct help message is printed when a help flag like --help or -h is specified
test_TestNonHelpFlag: test that tests are run and no help message is printed when no help flag is specified
review_HELP_REGEX: review the HELP_REGEX pattern that validates the help message output contains all expected gtest flags
